title: Baseline SORC on GPT-2
hypothesis: Degenerate inputs score lowest. Structured inputs score above random baseline. Expert contexts score higher than shallow contexts.
context_version: v1 (original ISC-theory contexts in expert category)
finding: Expert scored at random baseline (0.020). Shallow scored highest (0.061). Model too small: GPT-2 has no encoded relational chains for the expert ISC-theory topics. Expert contexts are out-of-distribution for GPT-2.
conclusion: GPT-2 is insufficient for this test. Expert contexts must be in domains the model has deeply encoded. Upgrade to 7B+ model.
